description_en: Modifies the automatic backup policy of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的自动备份策略
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-backup-policy --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --preferred-backup-time 07:00Z-08:00Z --preferred-backup-period Tuesday --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The time range to back up data. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

The beginning and end of the time range must be on the hour. The duration must be an hour
parameters.help_zh: 备份时间，格式为HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 必须为整点，且间隔时间为1小时
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The days of the week to back up data. Valid values:

Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday

Separate multiple options with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期，取值：
Monday：周一。
Tuesday：周二。
Wednesday：周三。
Thursday：周四。
Friday：周五。
Saturday：周六。
Sunday：周日。

支持多选，请使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the data flashback feature for the instance. Valid values:

1: enables the data flashback feature. You must also enable append-only file (AOF) persistence by setting `appendonly` to `yes` in the parameter settings of the instance. Then, you can use the data flashback feature.
0 (default): disables the data flashback feature.

This parameter is available only for Tair (Enterprise Edition) DRAM-based and persistent memory-optimized instances. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭数据闪回功能，取值：
1：开启。同时，您还需确保已在实例的参数设置中开启AOF持久化（`appendonly`为`yes`），开启后，才能使用数据闪回功能。
0：关闭，默认值。
仅Tair（企业版）内存型和持久内存型支持该参数，更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en: The number of days for which you want to retain data backup files. Valid values: 7 to 730. Default value: 7
parameters.help_zh: 数据备份保留天数。默认7天，取值范围为7~730
parameters.name: backup_retention_period
